record.paper_title: The average size of a connected vertex set of a graph-Explicit formulas and open problems
record.context_brief: Normalized connected-set count for cubic graphs
record.original_question: For a graph G of order n, let c(G)=N(G)/2^n, where N(G) is the number of connected vertex subsets of G; this normalized count is at most 1 and measures how connected G is. Among simple connected 3-regular graphs, determine c_3, the limiting supremum of c(G). Which graph families, possibly including expander graphs, realize or improve lower bounds for this limiting supremum?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a finite simple graph $G$ on $n$ vertices, let $N(G)$ denote the number of vertex subsets $S\subseteq V(G)$ such that the induced subgraph $G[S]$ is connected (by convention include or exclude the empty set consistently; the choice does not affect the asymptotics), and define
$$c(G)=\frac{N(G)}{2^{n}}\in[0,1].$$
Let $\Gamma$ be the class of all simple, connected, $3$-regular (cubic) graphs, and define
$$c_{3}=\limsup_{G\in\Gamma,\,|V(G)|\to\infty} c(G).$$
Determine the exact value of $c_{3}$. In particular, identify infinite families of cubic graphs (for instance, families of cubic expanders) that achieve, or improve known lower bounds for, $c_{3}$.
artifact.category_tag: connected vertex subsets of cubic graphs
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work by Haslegrave (J. Graph Theory, 2022; arXiv:2105.13332) provides a new lower bound and the first nontrivial upper bound on the maximum growth rate of the number of connected sets of a cubic graph, answering related questions of Vince. However, the exact value of c_3 does not appear to have been pinned down, so the problem remains only partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The number and average size of connected sets in graphs with degree constraints
status_evidence.snippet: We give a new lower bound, and the first non-trivial upper bound, on the maximum growth rate of the number of connected sets of a cubic graph.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds on c_3 have been improved but the exact value is not determined.

status_evidence.title: Haslegrave - Journal of Graph Theory 2022
status_evidence.snippet: Answers two questions of Andrew Vince regarding the effect of degree constraints on general connected graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Vince's question on c_3 has been partially addressed by Haslegrave.
